zh.title: 房屋值多少钱：AVM、估税值、CMA 和 Appraisal 的区别
zh.seo_title: AVM、CMA 与 Appraisal 区别｜陈靖
zh.description: 同一套房子会有几个不同的“价值”。这篇比较线上估值 AVM、县政府估税值、经纪人 CMA 和持牌估价师 Appraisal 的用途与局限，并给出房主日常跟踪房屋价值的方法。
zh.lead: 网站估值、税单和经纪人给的数字常常对不上，这并不奇怪，因为它们回答的是不同的问题。弄清每个数字的用途，才知道什么时候该看哪个。

en.title: What's My Home Worth? AVMs, Assessed Value, CMAs and Appraisals
en.seo_title: AVM vs CMA vs Appraisal for Owners | Jing Chen
en.description: Online AVMs, assessed value, agent CMAs and licensed appraisals answer different questions. Learn what each is for and how to track your value.
en.lead: Online estimates, your tax bill and an agent's number rarely match, and that is expected. They answer different questions, so it helps to know which one to use and when.
